$comment: Committed on purpose: the process is a property of the repository, not of
whoever's laptop is open. CLAUDE.md says what to do; this makes the two
steps that were actually being missed mechanical.
SessionStart installs the pinned toolchain and locates pie-parser, so 'I
could not run the tests' stops turning into 'the tests should pass'. Stop
blocks a turn that ends on unverified source edits. Neither runs the suite
on a timer — the stop-hook compares a content signature against the stamp
verify.sh writes, so a turn that changed nothing costs nothing.
